description: This file defines the PdfIntegerObject class, representing an indirect 32-bit signed integer value within the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors, a property to access the integer value, and methods for string representation and writing the object.

classes.name: PdfIntegerObject
classes.description: Represents an indirect 32-bit signed integer object in a PDF document, inheriting from PdfNumberObject, with mechanisms for initialization, output, and value retrieval.

methods.name: PdfIntegerObject(int value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a specific integer value.

methods.name: PdfIntegerObject(PdfDocument document, int value)
methods.description: Constructor that associates the object with a PDF document and initializes with a specific integer value.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the integer value using invariant culture.

methods.name: WriteObject(PdfWriter writer)
methods.description: Writes the integer object to a PDF writer, including object boundaries and value.
